source.title: Full gameplay lifecycle acceptance: fresh install to autonomous settlement, missions and breeding
source.body:
## Purpose
Audit and close the **ordinary-player, end-to-end gameplay journey**. A feature passes only when it can be reached from normal play, executes real state changes, refuses invalid actions without partial mutation, survives save/reload and can resume after interruption. Definition/readability/provenance-only smokes do not substitute for this.

### Evidence and boundaries (2026-11-18)
- Audited `main`: `8ffc2eaad92be75168cd57f096decc240ef1cfaf`.
- Existing fixes under review: PR #51, head `2d52afdc8f877b8d12ec0be68a468d1e33549fb4`. Java 17 milestone and multiplayer loopback checks **passed** for that PR; this is **not merged into main**.
- PR #51 corrects second-run state leakage, item/provenance/container drift, packing carried supplies into construction pools, built-cot Rest interaction, XP-to-knowledge-credit earning and stale purchase, combat pursuit and expensive semantic asset candidate selection. The new `CoreGameplayBoundarySmoke` and `KnowledgeProgressionIntegrationSmoke` run in isolated, synthetic worlds; do not overclaim continuous campaign or ordinary in-world acquisition.
- Published 0.9.53 is an **older** verified MSI/DEB lifecycle release and does not certify this HEAD. Installer/readback and continuous graphical playthrough must be rerun on the eventual accepted commit.
- Existing detailed source-level audit and repaired/remaining findings: `ROOT_docs/DEVELOPMENT_HISTORY.md`, sections “Core gameplay journey audit and final review” and “Earned knowledge and persisted-cot integration repairs”.

### Required sequential acceptance scenario
Use a **fresh, non-debug player**, on at least two deterministic map seeds plus a hostile/space-constrained seed; record seed, exact commit, inputs, transition results, asset/render readback where relevant, and save snapshots.

| Stage | Execution proof required | Current gap / caution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Install and boot | Fresh Windows MSI and Linux DEB install, boot to menu, update/prerelease discovery, preservation of saved data, rollback/reinstall and uninstall as applicable | Prior 0.9.53 package verified, not latest source/PR |
| 2. World setup and character | Choose character/job/name/settings, launch world, move/interact, start second fresh run without inheriting state, reload saved character | PR #51 fixes isolation; actual end-to-end GUI journey unverified |
| 3. World generation/validation | Final validation **after population, economy, roof/road/clutter, tile compilation**; spawn-to-rooms/exits reachability, door/corridor access and cross-floor routes; distinguish fatal errors from tolerated diagnostics | `WORLDGEN_ACCEPTANCE` derives label from repair count; warnings can remain and validation is premature |
| 4. Obtain/claim space | Navigate to unclaimed or abandoned actual room, inspect rights and price, claim or buy, observe ownership/faction consequences; negative tests on occupied/faction-locked rooms | Room ownership components exist; independent playable faction founding is not implied |
| 5. Excavate/construct a new room | Mark wall or abandoned footprint, assign digging and material supply; structurally safe carve, path preservation, registered new room ID/ownership; alternatively construct annex via player orders | Player dig/clear-to-room-registration executor not located; faction strategic annex is a different flow |
| 6. First shelter and survival | Acquire supplies/textiles/tools through ordinary salvage/vendor/contracts, place and finish cot/water/storage/workbench, use Rest; real hunger/thirst/sleep progression over move/wait/work + food/water use | PR #51 repairs cot/bootstrap; ordinary needs drain and full material acquisition still open |
| 7. Missions/contracts/jobs/trade | Discover, accept, execute, verify, turn in and receive exactly one payment/reputation/XP reward for market, production, bounty, fetch, trade and job missions; cancellation, stale target and save/reload | Market/production work exists; bounty/fetch and other objective lifecycle not established |
| 8. Player faction and relations | Found independent controllable freehold, recruit willing NPC into persistent roster, assign ranks/roles, pay/care; diplomacy, reputation and rival reaction mutate properly | World-side freehold metadata exists; room claim still controls shared HIVER space; ordinary player recruit admission unproven |
| 9. Automated construction | Assign workers to job + materials + storage/hauling, complete work over ticks, obey access/capacity, cancel/refund reservations and recover on save/reload | Generic blueprint contract chain is substantially readiness/audit; actual NPC faction shell construction not a player job pipeline |
| 10. Fabrication/facilities/storage | Construct and staff real machine, procure recipe inputs, repeat queued work, consume inputs, create item instances + provenance, route to correct storage/floor, obey capacities; run while player elsewhere/in another zone | Real turn-driven staffed queues pass focused tests; fully autonomous hauling / player-absent faction stock accounting unproven |
| 11. Livestock and pets | Adopt/tame/buy **living actor**, establish durable ownership, pet/handler, feed/water/pen/care, mate, gestate, spawn persistent offspring with capacity/traits; save/reload before/after birth | Source/product provenance and pet feedback exist, acquisition/reproduction executor not located |
| 12. Crafting and progression | Craft food, weapons and armor at accessible facilities from normally acquired inputs; earn/discover recipes, knowledge and XP; demonstrate skill nodes vs named practice proficiency policy | PR #51 adds 25 earned XP per knowledge credit; use-based named proficiency remains unimplemented/undecided |
| 13. Extended campaign and recovery | 20–30 minute scripted + headful play, travel away/back, resume production, save/reload, insufficient stock/space, hostile attack, NPC death, cancellation, multi-zone/host continuity, repeat after update | Existing focused headless checks do not certify this continuous story |

### Priority and working order
1. **P1 foundational:** player's hunger/thirst/sleep tick, complete fresh-start+normal-acquisition proof, truthful post-placement worldgen acceptance, player founding + recruit admission.
2. **P1 settlement loop:** player excavation or registered annex building, assigned construction labor/material reservation, autonomous storage/hauling and away-zone continuity.
3. **P2 breadth:** complete bounty/fetch/job mission lifecycles, live animal acquisition and breeding, consistent crafting/proficiency/knowledge discovery, faction relations consequences.
4. **Certification:** exact-commit full campaign smoke and native installer lifecycle on target platforms; record actual results and commits/artifacts.

### Validation doctrine
- Preserve the user's release policy: only build/launch/run and required multiplayer/updater failures are automatic **release blockers**; visual, balance, style and other gameplay gaps are accurately reported as diagnostics or milestone acceptance failures, not silently converted to release gates.
- Do not reset user saves, overwrite unrelated changes, force push, auto-merge PR #51, or mark progress complete based on class names, report-only authorities, synthetic setup or smoke logs without real state mutation.
- Prefer extending the existing authorities and adding one integrated normal-player journey harness over another layer of sample-only audit classes.
- At each stage, record exact before/after state, where inputs came from, where results went, saved state and adverse-case no-mutation evidence.

- **Repository inventory caution:** the broad PR presently changes `ROOT_docs/REPOSITORY_FILE_MANIFEST.tsv` from a 45.7 MB `main` blob to a 6.5 MB PR blob. Do not mistake isolated-worktree enumeration for a certified full-checkout release inventory; review that delta before merger/release. Existing governance requires a full exact-commit inventory clearance.

Next P1 execution order: normal-player recruitment/founding + staffing, and player work-order excavation/construction with resource hauling, then the complete mission and animal acquisition/breeding loops.

### 2026-11-19 — First live NPC recruitment / workforce action

PR #51 branch extended through [`c60b9ed337728553c1061f1ceb5ec9358cc3c84c`](https://github.com/mrcalzon02/TheMechanist/commit/c60b9ed337728553c1061f1ceb5ec9358cc3c84c). **No merge to main, no installer/release.**

- [`6fde00053fe579bbb714565bfef3eefcab80887d`](https://github.com/mrcalzon02/TheMechanist/commit/6fde00053fe579bbb714565bfef3eefcab80887d): new `PlayerRecruitmentAuthority` and NPC-dialogue Hire/Dismiss controls. Recruitment requires a validated room claim, a nearby living adult non-service actor, stable actor ID, adequate faction standing when applicable, space and an upfront script signing payment. Rejections are non-mutating. Hired employees are the **actual persistent NPC identities**, serialized backwards-compatibly in existing `base.recruits`, usable in existing workbench staffing and staffed production; assigned stations become unstaffed on dismissal, queues are retained. Base capacity grows by 2 for each built cot up to 20. Character overview shows crew occupancy and sleep debt; present-zone deceased hires block machine execution.
- Extended the authoritative `CoreGameplayBoundarySmoke` to cover actual claim -> hire -> station assignment -> full save/load -> dismiss, plus minor/remote restrictions. Initial test on `6fde000` **failed** after Java 17 compilation at the “affordable signing quote” assertion because this direct-panel fixture never executed the normal new-game initializer and had **zero** carried script. [Failed gate logs](https://github.com/mrcalzon02/TheMechanist/actions/runs/44577492122). Multiplayer [passed](https://github.com/mrcalzon02/TheMechanist/actions/runs/44577491955).
- [`c60b9ed337728553c1061f1ceb5ec9358cc3c84c`](https://github.com/mrcalzon02/TheMechanist/commit/c60b9ed337728553c1061f1ceb5ec9358cc3c84c): fixture now explicitly supplies the 15 script normal new-game grants; failure message includes the quote reason if another preflight fails. [New Java 17 gameplay/package-seed gate](https://github.com/mrcalzon02/TheMechanist/actions/runs/44577923741) started; [multiplayer loopback](https://github.com/mrcalzon02/TheMechanist/actions/runs/44577923902) completed SUCCESS.
- Limitations: hired actors remain ordinary world NPCs with their existing civic origin; their roster entry allows staffed production, but this patch does not implement NPC physical pathing to shifts, recurring wages, player-independent faction identity, construction task assignment or logistics hauling. Full headful gameplay and exact-commit installer validation remain open.

Release policy unchanged: compilation/launch, required updater and multiplayer failures can block release; visual, balance and diagnostic defects remain separate.

### 2026-11-19 Milestone 06 continuation — authoritative vehicle actions and refusal parity

### 2026-11-19 follow-on — character-bound player vehicle titles

`main` fast-forward commit [`f36e7889c8`](https://github.com/mrcalzon02/TheMechanist/commit/f36e7889c834a448fa32f2b30ae3749c1daa637a) confirmed by remote ref readback. No PR #51 merge, force-push, native installer publication, or player-save mutation.

**Code changes:** new dealer purchases and lawful abandonment claims now persist `ownerPlayerId` from the existing canonical local character ID. `VehicleRuntimeAuthority.playerOwns` enforces that ID, and `VehicleAccessAuthority` uses it for operation, passengers, cargo, repairs and deployment. Player salvage also checks that player-owned wrecks belong to the *current* character. Faction seizure and dismantling clear the old ID. Character selection is required before establishing a new title. The vehicle inspection text distinguishes character-linked from legacy-name title records without displaying internal IDs.

**Compatibility / limitations:** Historical player-owned vehicles without `ownerPlayerId` still use exact recorded display-name compatibility, including the unresolved same-name ambiguity; the local deterministic character ID is not an authenticated remote account credential. Full independent-host identity binding must be verified separately before claiming hardened multiplayer ownership.

**Test additions:** the existing `Milestone06VehicleRuntimeFoundationSmoke` now creates a named character, verifies ID recording at purchase and claim, denies a second character with the same name/job but different birth identity, ensures denied vehicle operation/salvage preserve vehicle inventory and currency, verifies original-owner recovery, persisted stock identity, and legacy record compatibility. These are actual source-run assertions, not a continuous graphical campaign.

**Exact-commit verification:** CI has started for the new SHA: [Java 17 and Gate 3](https://github.com/mrcalzon02/TheMechanist/actions/runs/44621738619), [milestone validation](https://github.com/mrcalzon02/TheMechanist/actions/runs/44621738630), [multiplayer loopback](https://github.com/mrcalzon02/TheMechanist/actions/runs/44621738646). **Regression:** Extended the existing Milestone 06 vehicle runtime foundation smoke to inspect four actual physical object types repeatedly (owned car, public transit desk, motor-pool desk and taxi booth); assert no XP/turn/cooldown/stock mutation; successfully purchase a Machine part through the routed parts storefront; then assert insufficient-funds refusal leaves all state unchanged.

The unmerged PR head `2da3c9722f9751fbb3fae58737614f41aef71777` now has a real worker-construction lane: `PlayerRecruitmentAuthority` hires live adult NPCs using saved `sourceNpcId`; `PlayerConstructionCrewAuthority` follows selected NPC turns, pathfinds to staged materials and completes a real site; `Milestone03PlayerConstructionCrewSmoke` exercises claim, hire, staging, movement, labor and a save/readback against an isolated synthetic world. This is meaningful progress but does not yet certify a continuous naturally generated campaign.

**Next test needed before accepting the recruitment stage:** Absent/dead/departed recruited NPCs appear to remain in `game.factionRecruits` while `PlayerRecruitmentAuthority.toggle` requires a nearby live NPC to dismiss and `PlayerConstructionCrewAuthority.available` excludes dead and `Left Faction` actors. Verify a recoverable roster cleanup/replacement flow (including assigned machine/site cleanup, capacity, suspended jobs and save/reload), without allowing remote dismissal of healthy workers by a spoofed NPC reference. Source review only; no pass claimed.

This finding does not change the already committed `main` read-only transit QoL fix [`cc199d4786f13db0741fd209ff1d5f643ea964a8`](https://github.com/mrcalzon02/TheMechanist/commit/cc199d4786f13db0741fd209ff1d5f643ea964a8), and PR #51 remains unmerged.

### 2026-11-19 — PR #51 recruited-crew recovery (commit 407cf83847)

On the **existing PR #51 head branch only** (not merged, no new branch, main remains `cc199d4786f13db0741fd209ff1d5f643ea964a8`), committed and verified remote readback: [`407cf83847ad5e6d8aa45f27f0db51e0dfaa7410`](https://github.com/mrcalzon02/TheMechanist/commit/407cf83847ad5e6d8aa45f27f0db51e0dfaa7410).

- Added deterministic lookup of unavailable hired worker contracts: deceased, `Left Faction`, or absent from the loaded zone. Missing is explicitly described as uncertain (may still be alive elsewhere), not automatically dead/departed; healthy locally present workers remain ineligible for recovery.
- A new **Character > Overview > Review Lost Crew / Confirm Release** control requires the player physically inside their authoritative claimed base and two clicks in the **same game turn**. Subsequent verification checks the identical roster record and state. No background or automatic dismissal. Detached forged NPC references still cannot bypass live dialogue reach.
- Confirmed recovery removes only the matching worker from `factionRecruits`, clears player-owned station/construction assignments, and preserves work orders, staged materials, labor progress, world NPC state, and resources. The UI-only confirmation is invalidated by turn changes and cleared by new game/save load.
- Extended `Milestone03PlayerConstructionCrewSmoke` with normal claim/hire/physical work then death, off-base refusal, UI button presence, double-confirmation, stale latch, full campaign `Persistence.writeCore/readCore` reset/readback, resource/work preservation, replacement admission, departed/missing cases, and a same-ID detached-NPC dismissal refusal. The established Gate 3 suite already invokes this smoke.

**Certification: NOT YET VERIFIED on 407cf83847.** The Github API currently reports no check runs/Actions execution at the new PR SHA; earlier green PR checks apply only to `2da3c9722f...` and must not be relabeled. The PR currently reports `mergeable=false, mergeable_state=dirty` against today's `main`. Preserve PR #51 for reviewed conflict reconciliation before any integration; do not auto-merge. Exact-SHA Java 17, Gate 3, multiplayer and graphical campaign remain open.
